title: ML Studio 2026.11.14.3
notes:
- Bounced Playlist tracks and instruments now keep their original Mixer routing by default, leaving Mixer effects live. An optional setting prints the processing and routes the bounce to a clean free insert, with undo and redo support.
- Added optional automatic project-tempo fitting for samples dropped into the Playlist, using filename BPM or detected rhythm. Unrecognized material keeps its original speed.
- Added visible drag handles across Mixer layouts, clearer insertion markers and cancellation when dropping outside the Mixer. Selected insert groups keep their routing when moved.
- Windows Open and Save dialogs now offer Explorer context menus and file copy, cut and paste shortcuts. Added F2 file/folder renaming with collision protection on all platforms.
- Menus open on hover by default for new profiles. Existing saved choices remain respected; the option is available under General > Input.
- Added six Mixer recording pickup points and Off, When armed and On input-monitoring modes, with per-channel saved settings and undo support.
- Fixed Melli sending basic ML Studio routing and recording questions into generic conversation. Follow-up questions about missing controls now retain guide context instead of inventing buttons.
- Expanded the bundled User Guide to 624 articles, including every Workspace Visibility switch, missing-control troubleshooting and detailed documentation for the new workflows. Added visibility controls for the new preferences, Mixer grips and file-management actions.
